children: Australian shares were likely to open little changed on Monday as potential losses in mining stocks offset indicators of strength in gold stocks after a US inflation supported bullion.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) fell 0.02%, a 31.8-point premium to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark closed down 0.7% on Friday.
